result.topic_en: Calculations on the conformal mapping of the region between two circles onto an annulus, and on infinite products and theta-type series (sums of $(-1)^n q^{n(n-1)/2} z^n$) satisfying functional equations $f(\alpha z) = -\frac{1}{z} f(z)$, used to express the logarithm of the mapping function.
